title: Gold in Mexico and a Yucatan tour story
summary: The interviewer tells of two musicians touring Yucatan and returning with gold; Goudie notes Mexico paid in gold.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: You guys really had some experiences on those tours. I was thinking of that one, did you know Gert Morant? No, I haven't.
I knew him. I heard of him.

But you know, he and Octave Crosby went down to Yucatan, about that time you were in Tampico, I think. And, my God, they went nuts over me. They took this wood-burning train, you know, at the small tracks, back to the capital there, Medina. And the Yucatan Spanish made pictures of him and everything else. So there's film shorts of that somewhere. And they came back with $300 and gold.
Yes, that was gold. They didn't have no paper in Mexico. It was all gold. Everything was gold.
So that was something to get down there, then?
